verdicts.why: Sources disagree on how Keller dies (the MCU wiki says Elena stabs the knife into Keller's heart, killing him and the Shrike; Wikipedia has him burst into crystals first), so the record, which already says she must kill it, stays.
Valkyrie dies in the Paris battle in episode 4, and case BY-019 lists her among the dead and in its cast, so it belongs beside BY-018.
Killmonger kills Tony in his own reality in episode 6, and Killmonger's world is the app's place for it.
Stane is exposed at Stark Industries in Killmonger's reality, which the app shows as Killmonger's world.
The record's first sentence is Killmonger's episode 6 coup in his own reality (with case BY-009 set there), so Killmonger's world belongs beside Ultron's world.
Caliban sets off his grenades during the attack at the Munson farm, the record's own case FX-020.
The Silver Samurai kills Harada at Yashida's facility in the village of his birth, already shown as Yashida's mountain facility.
Madelyne dies on Genosha in the Sentinel attack (case FX-027, set in Hammer Bay, Genosha).
Madelyne dies on Genosha in the Sentinel attack (case FX-027, set in Hammer Bay, Genosha).
Episode 10 ends with Rogue, Nightcrawler, Beast, Xavier and Magneto meeting En Sabah Nur in ancient Egypt in 3000 B.C.
Episode 14 takes place in ancient Egypt, where Nur becomes Apocalypse and kills Magneto above the pharaoh's city.
The episode 10 mid-credits scene shows Apocalypse finding Gambit's card in present-day Genosha.
Rama-Tut abandons Candra and flees in ancient Egypt in episode 14.
In episode 13 Rama-Tut destroys the base in ancient Egypt, 3000 B.C.
Rama-Tut's reveal as Kang and his escape happen in ancient Egypt in episode 14.
Danger goes to Genosha and battles Xavier and the X-Men there until Polaris defeats her.
The episode and the Marvel Database call them only the Horsemen of Apocalypse; Final Horsemen is the comics name the four are based on.
Brotherhood is never said in First Class, Angel accepts Shaw's offer during the Division X attack, and that attack (case FX-010) is at the CIA base.
Brotherhood is never said in First Class (not in the dialogue); Erik simply leaves with Angel, Azazel, Riptide and Raven.
Brotherhood is never said in First Class, and the record's Division X fight (case FX-010) happens at the CIA base.
On screen Erik names Banshee among the dead and asks where Charles was when they needed protecting; the autopsy files shown are Angel's, Azazel's and Emma's, not Banshee's.
Shaw kills Armando during the attack on Division X, the CIA base (case FX-010).

Case FX-015's own cause is the last X-Men hiding in the China temple while Kitty holds Logan's mind in 1973, which is exactly this record, and set-up records carrying the same case as the next record is the files' usual pattern.
Episode 14 is set in ancient Egypt, where Bishop rescues Xavier after Apocalypse kills Magneto.
Cable attacks Adler on Muir Island, but the record also plainly describes helping Gambit escape Genosha (Slave Island), and the app shows TAS Genosha as Genosha (Earth-92131).
In episode 17 the trial of Graydon Creed, with Colossus as judge, is at the Acolytes' Savage Land base.
In episode 16 Danger fights Xavier, Cyclops and the X-Men on Genosha, which is also where X-Corp is attacked when Rogue frees everyone.
Gambit dies destroying Master Mold in the Sentinel attack on Genosha.
The Marvel Database lists Moscow (Red Square) for Red Dawn, the same place Colossus's record shows for this fight.
Xavier and Magneto are powerless in the Savage Land, where Sinister is defeated and Magneto parts as an enemy.
Magneto makes his stand on Asteroid M, which explodes in space in episode 10.
Magneto stops the black hole and is killed by Apocalypse in ancient Egypt in episode 14.
Xavier asks Moira to review Adler's work at the Muir Island Research Center.
Juggernaut and Black Tom assault Muir Island and take Lilandra.
Proteus escapes from Moira's Muir Island lab and she takes him back there; the X-Men's record for this episode already shows Muir Island.
Moira, on Genosha's council, dies in the Sentinel attack on Genosha (case FX-027).
The ski trip and the mob at the monastery are in the German Alps, shown as The Bavarian Alps on Gambit's and Rogue's records for the same episode.
Bishop finds Nightcrawler with the others in ancient Egypt in 3000 B.C. at the end of episode 10.
Creed's trial and the sword duel with Exodus happen at the Acolytes' Savage Land base.
Xavier and Magneto are powerless in the Savage Land, where Sinister captures them and the X-Men free them.
Xavier takes control of Magneto and restores power on Asteroid M before it explodes.
Apocalypse kills Magneto in front of Xavier in ancient Egypt, and Bishop later rescues him.

Case FX-027 itself says Magneto, presumed dead, is taken prisoner by Bastion in the attack and lists him in its cast, and this is his only record tied to it, so the link matches what the record describes.
FX-001 is the episode 13 Master Mold uprising; the episode 51 kidnapping is only an aftermath, and Trask's and Morph's episode 51 records carry no case.
Arkon asks Storm to come and save his planet from its weather chaos and only proposes after she does, so he does not take her there to be his bride.
Agatha escapes into her backyard in Westview, where Rio kills her with a kiss as the Westview residents look on.
The faked assassination happens at the Hotel Roosevelt in Los Angeles (the app's Hollywood); Area 51 was the previous episode.
By the binding rule, a person's file stays Deceased when only their Life Model Decoy carries on, and Davis himself died in episode 120.
The released Monolith energy brings Flint to life from Mack and Yo-Yo's fears, and Izel wonders why it made him, so she did not recreate him herself.
The real May was held at the Radcliffe house and then at the Baltic oil platform, never in Siberia, which belongs to her season 3 mission.
